title: MA3 window
caption: Moving-average window, median WAPE per half-year block, 119 Unilever Tier A SKUs (ABC 2026-02, single), stored rolling one-step forecasts, real data only. Over 2023-10..2026-02 on the 114 SKUs all four windows can score: MA2 0.299, MA3 0.280, MA6 0.291, MA12 0.284. Against MA3 (two-condition WAPE test, seed 20260921), full window then blocks: MA2 T [-0.005, +0.029], 34 better / 80 worse, blocks TTTTL; MA6 T [-0.010, +0.020], 58 better / 56 worse, blocks LTTTT; MA12 T [-0.015, +0.023], 64 better / 50 worse, blocks TTTTT. No window beats MA3 on the full window and in a majority of blocks.
verdict_detail: MA2 beats MA3: no (full window T, W in 0 of 5 testable); MA6 beats MA3: no (full window T, W in 0 of 5 testable); MA12 beats MA3: no (full window T, W in 0 of 5 testable)
criterion: MA2, MA6 or MA12 scores W vs MA3 on the full window AND in a majority of testable blocks (ALL cohort)
data_notes: Data note: product_key 150 / SKU 64861486, 2025-12 has a NULL quantity in Unilever_SKU_Demand_Fact_Real (net PHP 2.89, La Union source); it is counted as 0, the same treatment as the bake-off.
